nom: Paula's Choice Clear Pore Normalizing Cleanser

avis.titre: Unclogged my extremely clogged pores!!Unclogged my extremely clogged pores!!
avis.texte: I started using this cleanser alongside benzoyl peroxide about 2 weeks ago and so far i’m seeing amazing results. My pores were extremely clogged and caused a lot of inflammation and closed comedones on my face. I’m not even a month in and most of my acne bumps have cleared. However I do still have scars from the purging but it was 100% worth it so that my skin can rebuild.

avis.titre: Great cleanser that's gentle and helpful.
avis.texte: I've trier other Paula's Choice products, and have liked them. I decided to buy this Paula's Choice facial cleanser, and am very happy I did. First off, I'm really happy about the way this product arrived. It was sealed on the outside, which is really important to me when dealing with skincare products. There was no leaking or issues with the bottle, which I also appreciate. As for the cleanser itself, this is a gentle yet effective one. Its clear in color, and lathers nicely. It does a great job at removing oil, residues and makeup from my skin-without making my skin feel too dry. There's not much of any fragrance to this product, which may be of some importance to some people. My skin feels refreshed, and the feeling lasts several hours. I like that this cleanser is gentle enough for my combination skin; I have dry areas of my skin, plus some areas that get a little oily. Additionally, I have some areas that have enlarged pores or are prone to breakouts. This cleanser has helped with those issues, while still helpful at moisturizing my dry areas. It's an excellent cleanser that does exactly what I hoped it would, and I've only been using this for a few days now. I love the results I've seen thus far, and am continuing to use this cleanser every day. I like that a little goes a long way, and the price seems reasonable to me. I would recommend this product to others.

avis.titre: Gentle and good for everyday use
avis.texte: I decided to buy this since there wasn’t a whole lot of facial cleansers in this price range that were FSA available. I typically use whatever I find at Walgreens but decided I’d give this a try since I do have large pores and thought this could help minimize them. I didn’t see any drastic changes or improvements to my pores but have noticed how soft my skin is after each use. It’s very gentle and almost feels like it’s not working but surprising, it does seems to move all of my makeup with a single wash. I’ve purchased it several times and will continue to repurchase just because its gentle, leaves my face feeling soft and clean and is at a reasonable price compared to the others on the FSA list.
Ive been use this for a few years now, not harsh, cleans amazing, feels great. My skin looks really good.
Loooove this cleanser, it’s the only thing that works well on my oily skin!!
I like this product so I bought it for the second time but when I just received it the outside is dirty and the container has a gross film of dirt on it.

avis.titre: More detailed directions on how to use.
avis.texte: Really good product! Awesome quality! The only reason why I don't give it a 5 start review is because the directions on how to use are extremely generic and basic. Directions on how to use could be more specific.
I have sensitive skin and some products cause me to break out / gives me a rash. This face wash is great and leaves my skin feeling fresh and clean

This had been my favorite facewash for a while, I had attempted a different face wash after purchasing the product and my stubborn acne started coming back. I don't see myself trying a different product because this has been the only one that has helped my face and self esteem

I’ve been using this cleanser for about 4+ years now and keep coming back to it. I have really sensitive skin, so I have to be careful with what I use, but this one leaves my skin feeling clean and fresh without drying it out. It’s gentle, hydrating, and still does a great job getting all the dirt and makeup off. Plus, there’s basically no smell, which I love. I use this twice a day, every day, and probably use more than I’m supposed to. Even then, one bottle still lasts me about a month.
Es maravilloso yo elegí el pequeño para probar pero me gustó .

Here is a picture of what I use for my face which is both oily and dry. It has been hard finding the right face products for my skin. A lot of times it would clog my large pores, or I would have white heads along with dry/ red blotchy skin. Then I researched some of Paula’s Choice products. I picked out what I thought fit my type of skin. After some adjusting my skin has been the best it has ever been. I don’t have big blackheads, white heads, dry skin, or red blotches. And it feels great. In the morning I use the face wash, eye cream, and the daily hydrating fluid lotion. At night I use the face wash, the toner (make sure you let your face completely dry afterwards before moving on), I use 3 drops of the boost (let that dry), then I put on the night oil free moisturizer. Every Tuesday night I use the exfoliate instead of the toner. You let it dry completely. It takes about 15 minutes. I usually don’t put anything on after using the exfoliate because I am too tired to wait for it to dry. It works for me. Then about once a month or every two weeks on a Friday night, after using the toner, I use exfoliate rinse off treatment. Afterwards I finish with the boost and night moisturizer.

avis.titre: Improved my skin and renewed my confidence!
avis.texte: I never thought I would be a lucky enough person to post a review like this, but this product saved my skin! I struggled with painful red acne on my cheeks and chin and poor skin texture from blackheads and some scarring. I originally purchased this Paula’s Choice cleanser as a temporary replacement for the CeraVe Salicylic Acid Cleanser because it was sold out at all the stores near me. This product had the same active so I figured it would work well. This was the best choice I’ve ever made! I just finished my first bottle and the results are amazing. I wash with Paula’s Choice Pore Normalizing Cleanser (this product) and moisturize with CeraVe’s daily moisturizing lotion twice a day (morning and night) and also use a mineral sunscreen in the mornings. My skin type is Normal/Combination. My before pictures were taken December 2020 and the after pictures were taken March 1st, 2021. One after picture was taken in natural light from my window and the other was taken in artificial lights in my kitchen. I haven’t been this confident since pre-COVID and I’m finally comfortable taking pictures again. Thank you Paula’s Choice!
I like this face wash, but I bought this bag expected more to be in there, & it’s only half a bag. Just stick to buying the damn bottles.

After washing my face I felt my skin very clean not any oiliness. It feels little bit dry but just a simple moisturizer is working. I can see it will be very effective. It doesn’t make too much foam but even without it, I could feel that it’s working good. My skin feels fresh. I’m not fan of the smell but smell doesn’t stay long after washing.

avis.titre: I love this product plus more from this brand

Thank you so much I’m happy this brand popped up and thanks to the reviews I was willing to step out of my comfort zone. I’m happy I decided to give it a try!

I NEVER write reviews for products... but oh my gosh. This cleanser literally got rid of all of my hormonal cysts that i have been struggling with for years. the first pic is from july 1st and the second is from august 28th the same year. it got a little worse before it got better but it was sooo worth it. My skin is normal/dry combo and i have a lot of hormonal acne. It’s not drying or stripping it’s amazing!

avis.titre: Essential!! AM and PM for best results!
avis.texte: This has been working for over 6 years now. I found Paula’s choice through research after the worst lupus flare I’ve ever had combined with a skin picking phase, and my skin cleared up in two weeks. I haven’t felt the need to use foundation since. Every now and then I get a little bump but this stuff works before anyone notices.

Finally found a great face wash!!! I noticed a difference in using this stuff in just 3 days! I get very bad stress Acne where I don’t even want to go outside in public! It makes my skin feel very soft! But not oily!!

avis.titre: Works Great! Bottle Holds Back a Great Product
avis.texte: This is my favorite face cleaner. I’ve been using it for about 3 months now. But beware, the screw cap easily breaks. On both my bottles the screw cap broke off with half a bottle of cleaner left. This is extremely frustrating as it’s not the cheapest cleaner. I travel with the bottle so sometimes it is upside down in my bag. The cap will fill with the cleaner and I believe this is what’s causing the cap the break. It’s difficult to tell in the photos but the reason the cleaner is leaking down the bottle is because it was caught in the cap. Once the cap broke it starts to leak. I hope they fix this issue.

I've been using this cleanser for over 10 years and it's still my go-to! It's gentle yet keeps my skin clear and fresh without any dryness! 0.5% of Salicylic acid... YES PLEASE! It's perfect for keeping breakouts in check! A must-have in my skincare routine!
Love the product but disappointed that the cap was not on the item or in the box when it arrived.

This is horrible soap. I don’t know why a salicylic acid soap would break you out. It’s supposed to do the opposite and it caused a reaction on my skin. The picture proves it returning! Stay away from this. My skin was perfect before I used this!

avis.titre: Best cleanser I’ve tried yet for blackheads and large pores!
avis.texte: For only $13 you get quite a bit compared to some of the other Paulas Choice products. I’ve only used this twice and I can already see the pores in my nose and cheeks shrinking. It isn’t too drying. I would say this is good for oily/combination skin. If you’re more on the dry side this probably isn’t gonna work for you. I put it next to a bottle of listerine for size reference. Lathers nicely. Doesn’t have a scent. This one is a winner in my book!

avis.titre: Paula's Choice = My ONLY CHOICE Forevermore
avis.texte: So pleased with the results so far. Have blackheads on my nose, and they are stubborn to get them alone downsized alone with just cleanser. With hot showers with an exfoliant mask once a week, and then this daily cleanse... MASSIVE improvements. This hands down is the best BRAND of skincare on the market right now. Easy to read/understand the ingredients, and how to pick cleanser/tone/exfoliant/plus moisturizer- based on skin texture/tone/ & condition. Do yourself a favor- TREAT YO SELF 2020 & get this skincare brand the hype it deserves.

avis.titre: Miracle for my extremely sensitive skin
avis.texte: I've wasted so much money trying to use proactive, Cetaphil, cerave the list goes on and on. This works amazing and lasts a long time. It doesn't burn me or make my skin peel. I have pcos and hashimotos I would suggest the 3 step system to start if your skin is as bad as mine then go to just the cleanser that's what I do.
